name: python-interview-canary-20-v1
purpose: Selected Python PR gate for obvious security and correctness regressions plus their clean public-fix directions

agentic_checkpoint.execution_method: cached-only merge of successful case reports plus policy and evidence replays

budget_recheck.conclusion: The earlier worker failures were reproduced as undersized per-role budgets and disappeared at the stable profile budget.

limitations: This is a deliberately selected obvious-defect canary, not an unbiased estimate of production PR-review accuracy.
The four security risk records transparently reverse public security fixes; the six correctness risk records transparently reverse public bug fixes.
The 20-case agentic checkpoint combines compatible cached executions created during incremental development and therefore is not a uniform run of all records at the final commit.
The current implementation commit is covered by 134 local tests and the exact 20-case deterministic run; a release-level claim still requires repeated uniform model runs from this commit.
Severity classification remains weaker than defect detection: 70% of matched findings used the labelled severity, while all required defects were still found.
